lua_assertions:
local function p(level, name, ...) return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...) end
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(1.375)
p('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '')
p('Song', 'CMod', 400, 2)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(1.5)
assert(p('Current', 'CMod') == 237.5)
assert(not _ITG_USING_MODIFIER(0, 'C237.5'), 'the partially approached spacing field still differs')
p('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '')
p('Current', 'MMod', 700)
assert(p('Current', 'XMod') == 1)
assert(not _ITG_USING_MODIFIER(0, '1x'), 'X FromString would clear MaxScrollBPM')
assert(_ITG_USING_MODIFIER(0, 'm700'))
p('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '')
assert(_ITG_USING_MODIFIER(0, 'm0'), 'inactive M0 leaves the underlying fields unchanged')
